item.title: Articulation
item.description: Articulatory organs Speech is formed by continuous articulatory movements from the voice produced by vocal cords in the larynx.

item.title: Excitation
item.description: Excitation forms One of the basic factors in the creation of speech sounds is the excitation, i.

item.title: Speech wave
item.description: The speech wave shows the change of the sound pressure of the radiated speech sound over time.

item.title: Spectrum of speech
item.description: The spectrum of the speech sound shows the frequency components of the vibration of the radiated speech wave (at a given moment) and the amplitude of each component.

item.title: Intensity of speech sounds
item.description: In speech, the amplitude of the radiated voiced speech sound is determined by the amplitude of the fundamental voice (in larinx).

item.title: Sound durations in speech
